model_family: MultiScale CNN + Temporal Self-Attention + RR Cross-Attention
input_notes: ecg: 2 lead x (denyut kini, denyut sebelumnya), urutan kanal [current_lead1, current_lead2, previous_lead1, previous_lead2]. RR: 8 fitur temporal yang distandardisasi memakai scaler per skema.
source_preprocessing: Bandpass Butterworth order 3 0.5-40 Hz (zero-phase sosfiltfilt), median subtraction, normalization by 95th percentile abs with minimum 0.05, clamp to [-5,5], RR feature normalization by training scaler and clamp [-8,8]. R-peaks in original evaluation are from MIT-BIH expert annotations.
warning: Research prototype only. Never claim general raw-upload clinical diagnosis.

4.inference_rule: Compute softmax(logits) for each seed; average probabilities for ensemble; then compute softmax(log(max(mean_probs,1e-8)) + logit_bias).
